representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands few (3) high-density items compared side-by-side with location object; source renders exactly that: 3-column matrix with 6 criteria + fit + rent + note rows (app.js:94-127, data.js:24-46) beside a geo-context SVG map with pins/metro/commute-anchor/rivals (index.html:29-114); both viewports show the full comparison surface (1280x860.png, 1440x900.png).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Comparison matrix is the dominant permanent surface (region-matrix flex:1, styles.css:137) and occupies ~2/3 width in both screenshots; fit-score row is visually primary (19px bold scores + rank chips, styles.css:189-196; visible as 57/34/63 in both viewports) with the decide action ('锁定选择：C 环汇广场·商场铺') in the persistent verdict bar at the bottom of both screenshots.

time_to_understand.evidence: h1 '梧桐区二店选址决策台' plus one-sentence lead stating task and layout ('3 个候选铺位…地理语境（左）与比较矩阵（右）同屏驻留', index.html:15-16); A/B/C column keys, fit numbers, rank chips and '优' badges legible at first glance in 1280x860.png; footer states data is illustrative (index.html:141).

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero structural navigation: single main screen, all 3 candidates visible simultaneously; selection reachable 1 step via column-header button (app.js:99, 327-330), map pin click (index.html:77-94), or keyboard ←→ / 1–3 (index.html:18-23, app.js:361-369); no routes, tabs or dialogs exist in source.

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions preserve context: weight slider input re-renders in place (app.js:241-247), lock/unlock swaps verdict-bar content without leaving the screen (app.js:300-309), selection bidirectionally links matrix column ↔ map pin (app.js:182-209) and draws walk-line + '步行 x′' label on the map (app.js:192-204); comparison state stays on-screen per app.js init '首帧即 ready' (app.js:394).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Five permanent panels each map to a brief need — map (acceptance seed), matrix (comparison=task), 6 weight sliders + reset (decide inputs, app.js:232-248), verdict bar (decision output, app.js:265-298), compact header/legend — no decorative or redundant surfaces found in source or either screenshot; the 4-line keyboard-hint block (index.html:18-23) is the only marginal surface and is auto-hidden under 1080px (styles.css:256-259).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast pass, a11y.focus_order pass, a11y.target_size pass (measurement-summary.json checks); focus-visible outline (styles.css:37), pins as role=button with Enter/Space handling (index.html:77, app.js:336-340), aria-pressed kept in sync (app.js:189), aria-live verdict (index.html:137), labeled sliders with output (app.js:236-238). Deduction: type.min_projected_size FAIL (measurement-summary.json:16), consistent with pervasive 10–13px type (styles.css:25 body 13px; :47 panel-sub 11px; :91 map-micro 10px; :154 badge-best 10px).

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects in either viewport: layout.overflow pass, layout.responsive_collision pass, text.truncation pass (measurement-summary.json) and 1280x860.png/1440x900.png show no clipping/overlap (matrix note row scrolls within #matrix-wrap, styles.css:138). Deduction: the single failed check type.min_projected_size is a real defect implying fix/rework, plus 1 unidentified warning in the receipt summary.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '地理语境与决策项同屏' is met structurally and visually: geo context (river/metro/江北商务区 anchor/competitors/flows, index.html:29-114) and the 3 decision columns co-reside on one screen at both viewports; selecting a candidate updates map pin, walk-line to its station and map-info with commute minutes (app.js:193-204), and map row-hover highlights related geo layers (app.js:211-229).

scores.overall_note: This package presents a coherent decide×comparison-panel console whose primary representation matches the brief almost exactly: a three-column high-density comparison matrix with a weighted fit score, a persistent geo-context map satisfying the acceptance seed ('地理语境与决策项同屏'), six weight sliders that recompute in place, and a persistent verdict/lock bar that keeps the decision state on-screen — visible in both screenshots and confirmed by the source (app.js:94-127, 232-309; index.html:29-137). The app initializes synchronously with inlined data and no loading state (app.js:379-395, data.js:3), meeting the first-screen-ready constraint, and the whole primary task is reachable with zero navigation. Measurement supports quality: 6/7 checks pass including all three a11y checks and all layout checks, with target_invalid false. The only observed defect is the failed type.min_projected_size check, consistent with a deliberately compact 10–13px type scale (styles.css:25,47,91,154), plus one unidentifiable warning in the sanitized summary; these cap accessibility and frontend-rework at 4 rather than 5. Model-judged proxy only: no human study exists, so time-to-understand is a label proxy and human preference, task time and retrieval accuracy are not observable here.
